description: This file contains a test implementation of the ICacheMonitor interface, including methods to track cache pressure, size, message statistics, and memory usage, along with a serializable class for counters with Orleans serialization attributes.

classes.name: CacheMonitorForTesting
classes.description: A test implementation of ICacheMonitor that increments counters for various cache-related events.

classes.name: CacheMonitorCounters
classes.description: A serializable class holding counters for cache monitoring, with Orleans serialization attributes.

methods.name: TrackCachePressureMonitorStatusChange
methods.description: Tracks changes in cache pressure status by incrementing the corresponding counter.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports cache size by incrementing the corresponding counter.

methods.name: ReportMessageStatistics
methods.description: Reports message statistics by incrementing the corresponding counter.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Tracks memory allocation events by incrementing the corresponding counter.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Tracks memory release events by incrementing the corresponding counter.

methods.name: TrackMessagesAdded
methods.description: Tracks messages added to cache by incrementing the corresponding counter.

methods.name: TrackMessagesPurged
methods.description: Tracks messages purged from cache by incrementing the corresponding counter.
